expected_findings.description: Timeout test should add a comment explaining why it intentionally bypasses `_seed_control` and directly seeds the `worktrees/` directory instead.

Function silently returns the alphabetically-first valid Change worktree when multiple exist, but this behavior is undocumented despite the docstring and plan implying only a single worktree should exist.
Test does not explicitly assert that the worktree name is not a merge-scratch directory like `.merge-aaa`, though the positive assertion is sufficient.
